finalText:
Build's clean now, exit 0.

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:
1. `resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read the new field.
2. `isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when the flag was `undefined`. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest of the warning wall was just deprecation noise from the version bump — nothing else to fix there.
